title: Environment-scoped Ephemeral API Key Framework and Rotation Orchestration
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Replace/augment existing long-lived service tokens with a first-class environment-scoped ephemeral key model and rotation orchestration. Goals: (1) reduce blast radius by defaulting new keys to short TTLs tied to environment (dev/stage/prod) and role, (2) provide server-side automated rotation with KMS-wrapped payloads and admin-initiated re-issuance, (3) preserve seamless developer ergonomics via token-exchange for legacy clients, and (4) create a clear audit crosswalk that links keys to SSO identities and RBAC v2 roles for post-incident analysis.
acceptance_criteria: New key issuance API supports environment tag and TTL override with sensible defaults (dev=12h, stage=48h, prod=168h)
Automatic background rotation scheduler rotates production keys within configured windows and updates KMS-wrapped secret store atomically
Audit log entries contain: key_id, issuing_identity (SSO user or service principal), environment, role_bindings, rotation_event_id, and previous_key_hash for traceability
Admin console shows token lineage and allows immediate revocation and emergency rotation with transparent metrics
Backward compatibility: legacy long-lived tokens are accepted for read-only workloads during migration via token-exchange proxy for up to 90 days
E2E integration tests cover issuance, rotation, exchange, revocation, and audit log ingestion into current observability pipelines
migration_plan: Phase 0 (internal alpha): implement issuance, rotation, and audit metadata for internal services only
Phase 1 (internal canary): enable for 10% of infra service tokens and require SSO mapping for issuers
Phase 2 (public beta): opt-in for customers; provide SDK token-exchange helper and docs
Phase 3 (enforced): set new default for new tokens and provide 90-day migration window for existing long-lived tokens
DB change: add token_metadata columns: environment, role_binding_ids (denormalized string), issued_by, expires_at, rotation_parent_id
Provide a one-click migration tool in Console to bulk-exchange legacy tokens to ephemeral short-lived ones for Dedicated customers
rollout_plan: Week 1: internal alpha deploy on staging, smoke tests, and security review
Week 2: enable internal canary on a subset of infra services; monitor token churn, API error rate, and auth latency
Week 3-4: open beta to select customers with guides and SDK helpers; run migration trials with account teams
Week 5: evaluate metrics and security review feedback; proceed to phased enforcement if stable
tradeoffs: Short TTLs drastically reduce risk of leaked tokens but increase token churn and complexity for long-running jobs
Token-exchange proxy preserves compatibility but adds latency and one additional network hop for legacy clients
Embedding environment and role metadata in token records improves forensic analysis but increases DB cardinality and storage costs
Fully enforcing ephemeral keys may require partner work for customers with air-gapped on-prem deployments; provide an escrowed long-lived option with stricter auditing
